renamer.content.introTitle: What is Batch Image Renaming and Why Does It Matter?
renamer.content.introP1: Digital cameras, smartphones, scanners, and design software typically export images with generic filenames like IMG_3921.JPG, DSC_0044.PNG, or Screenshot 2026-08-25 at 4.12.33 PM.png. While these default names work well for cameras storing memory, they are unsearchable, messy, and lack context for human users and search engines.
renamer.content.introP2: Renaming dozens or hundreds of files manually by clicking into individual file properties on your computer or phone is tedious and error-prone. ImgFeel's Batch Rename Images Online tool solves this by providing a streamlined, interactive two-panel workspace where you can view large image previews, navigate through photos, edit filenames in a compact list, and download individual files or a packaged ZIP archive in seconds.
renamer.content.howToTitle: How to Rename Multiple Images Online
renamer.content.howToDesc: Renaming your image collection takes just a few clicks without installing software or creating an account:
renamer.content.step1Desc: Click 'Choose Images' or drag and drop your photos into the upload zone. You can select single files, multiple photos, or entire batches at once.
renamer.content.step2Desc: Select any image from the sidebar to inspect it in the large preview window, or use the Next and Previous arrow buttons.
renamer.content.step3Desc: Edit individual filenames directly, or use the batch menu to apply sequential numbers, date stamps, prefixes, suffixes, or find-and-replace across all images.
renamer.content.step4Desc: Click the Delete icon on any card if you uploaded a duplicate photo or decided not to rename that specific file.
renamer.content.step5Desc: Click 'Download' on any individual photo, or click 'Download All (N)' to bundle the entire renamed batch into an in-memory ZIP archive.
renamer.content.whyBulkP1: Clean, descriptive filenames are fundamental to modern digital file management. Whether you manage ecommerce product catalogs, organize family holiday albums, publish blog articles, or archive client creative assets, meaningful file names prevent confusion and save hours of searching.
renamer.content.whyBulkP2: For web developers and digital marketers, image filenames directly influence SEO (Search Engine Optimization). Google Image Search and other search engines evaluate filenames to understand image content. Renaming 'IMG_8910.jpg' to 'handmade-leather-wallet-brown.jpg' significantly improves organic search discovery.

renamer.content.betterNamesTitle: Best Practices for Creating Better Image File Names
renamer.content.betterNamesDesc: Follow these professional naming guidelines to ensure maximum clarity, compatibility, and search visibility across all platforms:
renamer.content.tip1Desc: Use hyphens (my-photo-name.jpg) rather than spaces or underscores. Hyphens are recognized as natural word separators by all web browsers and search engines.
renamer.content.tip2Desc: Keep filenames strictly lowercase to avoid case-sensitivity conflicts when migrating files between Windows, macOS, Linux, and web servers.
renamer.content.tip3Desc: Include the subject, location, color, or primary context (e.g., 'sunset-over-alps-mountain.jpg' instead of 'photo1.jpg').
renamer.content.tip4Desc: Do not use symbols like /, \, :, *, ?, ", <, >, |, #, %, or & in filenames, as they can cause operating system errors and broken links.

renamer.content.privacyTitle: Is It Safe to Rename Images Online?
renamer.content.privacyP1: Yes, ImgFeel's Batch Rename Images Online tool is completely secure and privacy-friendly. The tool utilizes the modern HTML5 File API and JavaScript to inspect, rename, and package your images locally on your device.
renamer.content.privacyP2: Your photos never leave your device, are never transmitted over the internet, and are never stored on external databases or cloud servers. You get fast desktop-grade utility with complete confidentiality.
renamer.faq.q1: How do I rename multiple images at once?
renamer.faq.a1: Simply upload your images to this tool, select a naming mode or edit the filename input next to each thumbnail preview, and click 'Download All' to save all renamed images in a ZIP file.
renamer.faq.a2: Our batch renamer supports all popular web and camera image formats, including JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, and SVG.
renamer.faq.q3: Does renaming modify the original image quality?
renamer.faq.a3: No. The tool performs pure lossless file renaming. The underlying image data, pixels, resolution, and color profiles remain 100% untouched.
renamer.faq.q4: Are my uploaded photos sent to a server?
renamer.faq.a4: No. All file processing occurs entirely within your web browser on your local device. Your images are never uploaded to any remote server or stored anywhere.
renamer.faq.q5: What happens to the file extension when I rename a file?
renamer.faq.a5: The tool automatically preserves the original file extension (.jpg, .png, .webp, etc.), preventing corrupt or unreadable files even if you omit the extension in the input field.
renamer.faq.q6: Can I use this tool on a mobile phone or tablet?
renamer.faq.a6: Yes! The tool is fully responsive and touch-friendly. You can upload photos from your smartphone camera roll, inspect previews, edit filenames, and download them comfortably.
renamer.faq.q7: How do I download all renamed images together?
renamer.faq.a7: When you have two or more images in your workspace, click the 'Download All' button at the bottom of the sidebar to download an in-memory ZIP archive containing all your renamed files.
